points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 斯大林出生于格鲁吉亚哥里的一个贫困鞋匠家庭，原名约瑟夫·维萨里奥诺维奇·朱加什维利。他的童年充满艰辛，父亲酗酒早逝，母亲是虔诚的东正教徒，靠做洗衣工维持生计。斯大林在教会学校接受教育，表现出优异的学习能力，但也展现出叛逆性格。这段经历塑造了他对宗教的复杂态度，以及对社会不平等的早期认识。
points.descriptionEn: Stalin was born in Gori, Georgia, to a poor cobbler family. His father died early from alcoholism, and his mother, a devout Orthodox Christian, worked as a laundress to support the family. Stalin received education at a church school where he excelled academically but also displayed rebellious tendencies. These formative years shaped his complex relationship with religion and his early awareness of social inequality.

points.title: 革命活动家
points.description: 斯大林进入第比利斯神学院学习，但很快投身革命活动，1899年因参加革命活动被开除。他加入俄国社会民主工党，成为布尔什维克派成员，积极参与革命宣传和组织工作。在此期间，他多次被捕流放，但每次都能逃脱或获释。1905年革命期间，斯大林在高加索地区组织武装斗争，展现出组织能力和冷酷无情的一面。这段经历为他日后在党内的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Stalin attended the Tbilisi Seminary but was expelled in 1899 for revolutionary activities. He joined the Russian Social Democratic Labor Party and became a Bolshevik, actively participating in revolutionary propaganda and organization. During this period, he was arrested and exiled multiple times but always managed to escape or be released. During the 1905 Revolution, Stalin organized armed struggles in the Caucasus, demonstrating his organizational skills and ruthless nature, laying the foundation for his future rise within the party.

points.title: 十月革命与内战
points.description: 1917年十月革命期间，斯大林担任《真理报》主编，积极参与革命宣传。革命后，他担任民族人民委员，负责处理少数民族事务。内战期间，斯大林被派往前线担任军事委员，表现出强硬手腕。1922年，他当选为党中央总书记，开始掌握党内实权。这一时期，斯大林与列宁建立了密切关系，同时也开始与托洛茨基等人产生分歧，为日后的权力斗争埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: During the October Revolution of 1917, Stalin served as editor of Pravda and actively participated in revolutionary propaganda. After the revolution, he became People's Commissar for Nationalities, handling minority affairs. During the Civil War, Stalin was sent to the front as a military commissar, demonstrating his tough approach. In 1922, he was elected General Secretary of the Central Committee, beginning to accumulate real power within the party. During this period, Stalin developed a close relationship with Lenin while also beginning to diverge from figures like Trotsky, laying the groundwork for future power struggles.

points.title: 权力巩固与工业化
points.description: 列宁逝世后，斯大林通过击败托洛茨基、季诺维也夫、加米涅夫等对手，逐步巩固了自己的权力。1928年，他启动第一个五年计划，推行强制集体化和快速工业化政策。这一时期，苏联经济迅速发展，但也导致了严重的饥荒，尤其是1932-1933年的乌克兰大饥荒，造成数百万人死亡。同时，斯大林开始进行大规模政治清洗，包括1934-1938年的大清洗运动，消灭了党内外的潜在反对者，建立了高度集中的个人独裁统治。
points.descriptionEn: After Lenin's death, Stalin gradually consolidated his power by defeating rivals like Trotsky, Zinoviev, and Kamenev. In 1928, he launched the first Five-Year Plan, implementing forced collectivization and rapid industrialization. During this period, the Soviet economy grew rapidly, but it also led to severe famines, particularly the 1932-1933 Holodomor in Ukraine that killed millions. Simultaneously, Stalin initiated large-scale political purges, including the Great Purge of 1934-1938, eliminating potential opponents within and outside the party, establishing a highly centralized personal dictatorship.

points.title: 卫国战争
points.description: 1941年德国入侵苏联后，斯大林领导苏联人民进行卫国战争。初期，苏军遭受重大挫折，斯大林一度陷入恐慌，但很快稳定局势，担任国防委员会主席和最高统帅。他采取了一系列措施，包括将工业设施东迁、实施焦土政策、动员全民抗战等。在斯大林格勒战役等关键战役中，苏军取得决定性胜利。1945年，苏联红军攻克柏林，斯大林作为战胜国领袖参加雅尔塔会议，确立了苏联战后的大国地位。这场战争极大地提升了斯大林在国内的威望，但也造成了约2700万苏联人的死亡。
points.descriptionEn: After Germany's invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, Stalin led the Soviet people in the Great Patriotic War. Initially, the Soviet army suffered major setbacks, and Stalin briefly panicked but soon stabilized the situation, becoming Chairman of the Defense Committee and Supreme Commander. He implemented measures including relocating industrial facilities eastward, scorched-earth policies, and mobilizing the entire population for resistance. In key battles like Stalingrad, the Soviet army achieved decisive victories. In 1945, Soviet forces captured Berlin, and Stalin attended the Yalta Conference as a victorious leader, establishing the Soviet Union's post-war great power status. The war greatly enhanced Stalin's prestige domestically but resulted in approximately 27 million Soviet deaths.

points.title: 冷战与晚年
points.description: 二战后，斯大林开始与西方世界对抗，开启冷战时期。他支持东欧国家建立社会主义政权，形成社会主义阵营。在国内，他继续加强中央集权，推行新的五年计划，恢复国民经济。同时，他再次进行政治清洗，包括著名的'列宁格勒案件'和'医生案件'。1953年3月5日，斯大林在莫斯科逝世，享年74岁。他的去世标志着苏联一个时代的结束，也引发了关于接班人权力的激烈斗争，最终由赫鲁晓夫上台并开始'去斯大林化'进程。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Stalin began confronting the Western world, initiating the Cold War. He supported the establishment of socialist regimes in Eastern European countries, forming the socialist bloc. Domestically, he continued to strengthen central control, implementing new Five-Year Plans to restore the national economy. Simultaneously, he conducted new political purges, including the famous 'Leningrad Affair' and 'Doctors' Plot.' On March 5, 1953, Stalin died in Moscow at the age of 74. His death marked the end of an era in the Soviet Union and triggered intense struggles for succession power, eventually leading to Khrushchev's rise and the beginning of the de-Stalinization process.

appraisal.zh: 斯大林的历史评价悬殊而尖锐。一种看法强调他推动工业化，使苏联迅速成为世界第二大工业国，并为二战胜利奠定物质基础；但更主流的学界判断认为，他建立极权统治，通过大清洗与古拉格镇压异己，集体化政策酿成1932至1933年乌克兰大饥荒，并借个人崇拜压制思想自由，其遗产主要是恐惧与苦难。他既是工业化的推动者，也是造成巨大人道灾难的独裁者，这一矛盾本身即是其历史定位的核心。
appraisal.en: Assessments of Stalin are sharply polarized. One view stresses that he drove industrialization, rapidly making the Soviet Union the world's second-largest industrial power and laying the material basis for victory in WWII. The more mainstream scholarly judgment, however, holds that he built a totalitarian regime, suppressing dissent through the Great Purge and the Gulag, that collectivization produced the 1932–1933 Holodomor, and that a cult of personality stifled intellectual freedom, leaving a legacy chiefly of fear and suffering. He was both an industrializer and a dictator responsible for immense human catastrophe, and that contradiction lies at the core of his historical standing.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为斯大林是伟大的领导者，他将落后的农业国转变为工业强国，为苏联赢得二战胜利奠定了物质基础。他推行的工业化政策使苏联在短时间内成为世界第二大工业国，增强了国家实力和防御能力。斯大林还致力于提高全民教育水平和医疗保健，使苏联在科技和军事领域取得重大突破。在支持者眼中，斯大林是一位坚定的爱国者和社会主义建设者，他的领导使苏联跻身世界强国之列。
supporter.en: Supporters view Stalin as a great leader who transformed the backward agricultural country into an industrial powerhouse, laying the material foundation for the Soviet Union's victory in WWII. His industrialization policies rapidly made the Soviet Union the world's second-largest industrial nation, enhancing national strength and defensive capabilities. Stalin also致力于 improving全民教育 and healthcare, achieving significant breakthroughs in science, technology, and military fields. In the eyes of supporters, Stalin was a steadfast patriot and socialist builder whose leadership elevated the Soviet Union to the ranks of world powers.

critic.zh: 批评者谴责斯大林建立了极权主义统治，通过大清洗、古拉格劳改营等手段镇压异己，造成数百万人死亡。他的集体化政策导致了1932-1933年乌克兰大饥荒等灾难性后果。斯大林还建立了个人崇拜，压制思想自由，扼杀了苏联社会的创造力和活力。在批评者看来，斯大林是一个残暴的独裁者，他的统治给苏联人民带来了深重灾难，其历史遗产主要是恐惧、苦难和死亡。
critic.en: Critics condemn Stalin for establishing a totalitarian regime, suppressing dissent through the Great Purge, Gulag labor camps, and other means, resulting in the deaths of millions. His collectivization policies led to catastrophic consequences including the 1932-1933 Holodomor in Ukraine. Stalin also established a cult of personality, suppressed intellectual freedom, and stifled creativity and vitality in Soviet society. In the view of critics, Stalin was a brutal dictator whose rule brought profound suffering to the Soviet people, with his historical legacy primarily consisting of fear, suffering, and death.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，斯大林是一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既推动了苏联的工业化和现代化，也造成了巨大的人道灾难。在流行文化中，斯大林常被描绘成极权主义的象征，他的形象反映了20世纪政治极端主义的悲剧。历史学界对斯大林的评价日趋多元，既承认其历史贡献，也不回避其罪行。斯大林主义作为政治现象，对20世纪国际关系产生了深远影响，其遗产至今仍在东欧和前苏联地区引发争议和反思。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Stalin was a complex and contradictory figure who both drove the industrialization and modernization of the Soviet Union and caused immense human suffering. In popular culture, Stalin is often depicted as a symbol of totalitarianism, reflecting the tragedy of 20th-century political extremism. Academic evaluations of Stalin have become increasingly diverse, acknowledging his historical contributions while not回避 his crimes. Stalinism as a political phenomenon profoundly influenced 20th-century international relations, and its legacy continues to spark controversy and reflection in Eastern Europe and the former Soviet region.

self.zh: 死亡一个人物是悲剧，死亡成千上万个人只是统计数据。
self.en: The death of one man is a tragedy, the death of millions is a statistic.
